title: Why Your Brain Can't Find a Word (Tip-of-the-Tongue)
description:
You know the word. You can almost say it. But it won't come out. This is the tip-of-the-tongue state: a temporary word-retrieval failure.

SOURCES:
- Brown, R. & McNeill, D. (1966). The “tip of the tongue” phenomenon. Journal of Verbal Learning and Verbal Behavior, 5(4), 325–337.
- Schwartz, B. L. & Metcalfe, J. (2011). Tip-of-the-tongue (TOT) states: retrieval, behavior, and experience. Memory & Cognition, 39, 737–749.
